class.name: PhysicsSystem2D
class.brief_description: Server-direct 2D physics integration for ECS entities.
class.description: [PhysicsSystem2D] provides the 2D equivalent of the physics synchronization backend, interfacing with [PhysicsServer2D]. It is designed for high-density 2D simulations like "Bullet Hell" patterns, swarm AI, or massive physics-based particle systems. [b]Design Philosophy:[/b] The 2D physics backend avoids the overhead of [Node2D] signals and lifecycle methods. It treats physics as a purely data-driven process, reading from [Transform2DComponent]s and writing collision results back to the ECS registry. [b]Note:[/b] Collision callbacks (area entered, body entered) are processed into a component-based queue for safety, allowing gameplay systems to respond to collisions during the parallel simulation pass without causing race conditions.

method.name: process_physics_updates
method.description: Flushes the current ECS transform state into the [PhysicsServer2D].

method.name: register_entity_physics
method.description: Manually creates a 2D physics body for the entity. Use this to bypass the [ECSPrefabBridge] if you are procedurally generating physics objects at runtime.

method.name: unregister_entity_physics
method.description: Immediately frees the server-side physics resources for the entity.

method.name: solve_kinematic_movement_2d
method.description: A server-direct Kinematic solver for 2D entities. Optimized for smooth sliding along surfaces and resolving high-speed collisions in a single pass.
